bias.en: Bearish · capped at the September low
bias.zh: 偏空 · 受制于 9月低点

read.en: Intel rose 1.4% on Oct 21 to $92.96, trading between $90.76 and $94.39. It is above the falling 5-day ($92.4) and rising 200-day ($85.4) averages, but below the falling 10-day ($97.6), 100-day ($106.3) and 30-day ($108.1). MACD has been below its signal since Oct 5 and is below zero, with the histogram narrowing; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 5 ($99.38), and RSI is 36.
read.zh: 英特尔 10月21日上涨 1.4%，收于 $92.96，盘中区间 $90.76–94.39。股价位于下行的 5 日（$92.4）和上行的 200 日均线（$85.4）上方，但低于下行的 10 日（$97.6）、100 日（$106.3）和 30 日均线（$108.1）。MACD 自 10月5日起位于信号线及零轴下方，柱状图收窄；抛物线 SAR 自 10月5日起看空（$99.38），RSI 为 36。

read.en: The close moved back above the 5-day average, but the day's high stopped at $94.4, just under the $94.5 September low. Resistance is $94.5, then $97.6–98.3 (10-day, June pivot) and $99.4 (SAR). Support is $92.4 (5-day), then $88.8 (Oct 20 low) and $85 (Aug 24 low, 200-day). A close above $94.5 would target $98.3; a close below $88.8 would open $85.
read.zh: 收盘重回 5 日均线上方，但盘中高点止于 $94.4，略低于 $94.5 的 9月低点。阻力为 $94.5，其次 $97.6–98.3（10 日均线、6月转折点）和 $99.4（SAR）。支撑为 $92.4（5 日均线），其次 $88.8（10月20日低点）和 $85（8月24日低点、200 日均线）。若收盘站上 $94.5，下一目标看 $98.3；若收盘跌破 $88.8，将打开 $85。
